name: Bank
applies_to: Banks: statements show interest earned/expended (interest income/expense), deposits and loans/advances.

rows.label: Gross Income
rows.hint: Gross income: interest income + fee and commission income + other non-interest income, before interest expense (an Indian bank's 'Total Income'). Leave out when not printed as one line: the program adds it up

rows.label: Gross Expense
rows.hint: Gross expense, negative, when printed as one line covering interest expense, operating expenses and provisions (an Indian bank's 'Total Expenditure' leaves out provisions). Otherwise leave out and list the lines in cost_of_sales_basis: the program adds the marked ones (without them, interest expense + operating expenses + allowances)

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.hint: Gross profit as printed. Leave out when not printed: the program calculates gross income + gross expense

rows.label: Interest Income
rows.hint: Interest earned / interest income on advances, investments and balances with banks; positive

rows.label: Interest Expense
rows.hint: Interest expended / interest expense on deposits and borrowings; negative

rows.label: Net Interest Income
rows.hint: Net interest income as printed; leave out if not printed

rows.label: Fee & Commission Income
rows.hint: Net fee and commission income, if shown separately

rows.label: Other Non-Interest Income
rows.hint: Trading, investment, insurance and other income (an Indian bank's 'Other Income'), excluding fees if shown separately

rows.label: Total Operating Income
rows.hint: Total operating income NET of interest expense, if printed. Leave out an Indian bank's 'Total Income' (interest earned + other income): that is Gross Income, and the program computes the net figure

rows.label: Staff Costs
rows.hint: Employee costs / payments to and provisions for employees; negative

rows.label: Other Operating Expenses
rows.hint: Other operating expenses (premises, depreciation, insurance service expenses, other); negative

rows.label: Total Operating Expenses
rows.hint: Operating expenses: staff costs + other operating expenses; negative. Not 'Total Expenditure', which also includes interest expended

rows.label: Operating Profit before Allowances
rows.hint: Operating profit before provisions and contingencies

rows.label: Allowances / Provisions for Credit Losses
rows.hint: Provisions (other than tax) and contingencies, allowances for credit and other losses; negative

rows.label: Share of Results of Associates
rows.hint: Share of profit/(loss) of associates and joint ventures shown BEFORE profit before tax

rows.label: Exceptional Items
rows.hint: Exceptional items as they affect profit: a charge is negative (an Indian bank's 'Profit before tax (7-8-9)' deducts them)

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.hint: Profit/(loss) before tax (Indian banks: profit from ordinary activities before tax)

rows.label: Taxation
rows.hint: Tax expense; negative

rows.label: Profit After Tax
rows.hint: Profit after tax BEFORE minority interest and any share of associates added after tax: the first profit line after tax (Indian banks: 'Net Profit from Ordinary Activities after tax (10-11)'). Not a bottom line that already deducts minority interest

rows.label: Share of Results of Associates (after tax)
rows.hint: Share of profit/(loss) of associates added AFTER tax (Indian banks: 'Add: Share of earnings in Associates' below profit after tax); leave out when associates come before profit before tax

rows.label: Profit Attributable to Shareholders
rows.hint: Profit attributable to owners / equity holders of the bank: the bottom line after minority interest and associates (Indian consolidated results: 'Net Profit for the period (12-13+14+15)' / 'attributable to the Group')

rows.label: Minority Interests
rows.hint: Profit attributable to non-controlling / minority interest; positive for a profit, even where printed as 'Less: Minority Interest'; the line under 'attributable to', not the discontinued operations line

rows.label: EPS - Basic (cents)
rows.hint: Basic EPS in the currency's minor unit (cents, paise: x100 if printed in dollars / rupees)

rows.label: EPS - Diluted (cents)
rows.hint: Diluted EPS in the currency's minor unit

rows.label: Cash & Balances with Central Banks
rows.hint: Cash in hand and balances with the central bank (e.g. Reserve Bank of India, MAS)

rows.label: Due from Banks / Placements
rows.hint: Balances with banks, money at call and short notice, placements with banks

rows.label: Investments & Securities
rows.hint: Investments, government and other securities

rows.label: Loans & Advances to Customers
rows.hint: Advances / loans and advances to customers, net of allowances

rows.label: Fixed Assets
rows.hint: Fixed assets / property and equipment

rows.label: Other Assets
rows.hint: Other assets, derivatives, goodwill (incl. goodwill on consolidation) and intangibles

rows.label: Total Assets
rows.hint: Total assets (an Indian bank's 'Total' of assets)

rows.label: Deposits from Customers
rows.hint: Deposits

rows.label: Due to Banks
rows.hint: Deposits and balances of banks, if separate from customer deposits

rows.label: Borrowings & Debt Issued
rows.hint: Borrowings, bonds, debt securities, subordinated debt

rows.label: Other Liabilities & Provisions
rows.hint: Other liabilities and provisions, derivatives

rows.label: Total Liabilities
rows.hint: Printed total; leave out if not printed. Never the 'Total equity and liabilities' / 'Total liabilities and equity' line (that equals total assets).

rows.label: Share Capital
rows.hint: Capital

rows.label: Reserves
rows.hint: Reserves and surplus / retained earnings + other reserves

rows.label: Perpetual Securities
rows.hint: Additional tier 1 / perpetual capital securities in equity

rows.label: Total Shareholders' Equity
rows.hint: Equity attributable to owners; leave out if not printed (the subtotal before non-controlling interests; ordinary equity when perpetual securities are shown after it)

rows.label: Minority Interests
rows.hint: Non-controlling / minority interest

rows.label: Total Equity
rows.hint: Total equity; leave out if not printed. Never the 'Total equity and liabilities' / 'Total liabilities and equity' line (that equals total assets).

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.hint: Starting line of the indirect method (profit before tax or profit for the period)

rows.label: Depreciation & Amortisation
rows.hint: Sum of depreciation and amortisation add-backs

rows.label: Other Non-Cash Adjustments
rows.hint: All other adjustments (interest, impairments, gains/losses, share of associates...) combined

rows.label: Operating Cash Flow Before Working Capital Changes
Working Capital Changes
rows.hint: Total of changes in inventories, receivables, payables, etc.

rows.label: Interest Paid
rows.hint: Only if classified in operating activities; negative

rows.label: Interest Received
rows.hint: Only if classified in operating activities

rows.label: Income Tax Paid
rows.hint: Negative

rows.label: Purchase of Property, Plant & Equipment
rows.hint: Capex incl. investment properties and intangibles if combined; negative

rows.label: Acquisition of Subsidiaries / Investments
rows.hint: Acquisition of subsidiaries net of cash, investments in associates/JVs/financial assets; negative

rows.label: Proceeds from Borrowings
rows.hint: Proceeds from borrowings, bonds, debentures and subordinated debt issued

rows.label: Repayment of Borrowings
rows.hint: Repayment of borrowings, redemption of bonds / debentures / subordinated debt; negative

rows.label: Payment of Lease Liabilities
rows.hint: Principal portion of lease payments; negative

rows.label: Interest Paid (Financing)
rows.hint: Interest paid in financing activities, incl. interest on bonds / subordinated debt; negative

rows.label: Dividends Paid
rows.hint: To owners and non-controlling interests combined (incl. dividend tax); negative

rows.label: Purchase of Treasury Shares
rows.hint: Negative

rows.label: Other Financing Activities
rows.hint: Other financing flows (e.g. minority interest contributions)

rows.label: Net Increase/(Decrease) in Cash
rows.hint: Net increase/(decrease) in cash as printed (it may include exchange differences when the filing prints them above it)

rows.label: Other Changes in Cash
rows.hint: Lines printed between the net change and cash at the end other than exchange rates: cash transferred to/from assets held for sale or a disposal group, bank overdrafts, restricted cash

rows.label: Cash at End of Period
rows.hint: Cash at the end of the period as the cash flow statement's roll-forward gives it, before any reconciliation to the balance sheet printed below it

rows.label: Free Cash Flow
rows.hint: Leave null; computed by the program as net operating cash flow + capex
